title: Indus Agent protocol

ANSWER_KIND_MISMATCH.meaning: the answer's kind differs from the kind of the server request it answers

CONFIRM_REQUIRED.meaning: the change needs an explicit confirmation; repeat the call with confirm set

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.meaning: the idempotency key was already used with different parameters

INTERNAL_ERROR.meaning: the server failed while handling a valid request

INVALID_PARAMS.meaning: the params do not match the method's model (unknown key, wrong type, missing field)

INVALID_REQUEST.meaning: the JSON value is not a valid request frame

METHOD_NOT_FOUND.meaning: no method with this name is declared

PARSE_ERROR.meaning: the frame is not valid JSON

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: no usable model provider could be resolved for the session

SERVER_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.meaning: no open server request has this id (never sent, already answered or withdrawn)

SERVER_REQUEST_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: the client cannot answer server requests of this kind

SESSION_BUSY.meaning: the session is running a turn or is held by another surface

SESSION_REFUSED.meaning: the session cannot be used: it was deleted or continued in another session

SHELL_REFUSED.meaning: the shell command is blocked by the dangerous-command rules and was not run

SHELL_TIMEOUT.meaning: the shell command did not finish within its time limit and was stopped

SLASH_NOT_OWNED.meaning: the server does not run this slash command; the client handles it, or a later release does

SLASH_WORKER_FAILED.meaning: the slash command's handler failed or did not answer in time

STORE_FAILED.meaning: the session store could not read or write the session

TEXT_EMPTY.meaning: the message text is empty or only whitespace

UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY.meaning: the params carry a key the method does not declare (the path names it)

UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND.meaning: the name is not a built-in, quick or skill command
